game.title: Mass Effect Legendary Edition
game.blurb: Remastered trilogy of the sci-fi action RPGs Mass Effect 1, 2 and 3, from BioWare, released 2021-05-14. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours (well under a full run of the trilogy). Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Mass Effect: The Story
chapters.summary: Commander Shepard's hunt for Saren, from Eden Prime to Ilos.

chapters.title: Mass Effect: Squad, Powers and Side Missions
chapters.summary: Squadmates, biotic and tech powers, uncharted worlds, the codex and Bring Down the Sky.

chapters.title: Mass Effect 2: The Story
chapters.summary: Back from the dead, the Collectors and the suicide mission.

chapters.title: Mass Effect 2: Recruitment and Loyalty
chapters.summary: Recruiting the team and earning each member's loyalty.

chapters.title: Mass Effect 2: Side Missions, Upgrades and Combat
chapters.summary: Planet scanning, research, upgrades, powers, Overlord and the Shadow Broker.

chapters.title: Mass Effect 3: The Story
chapters.summary: The war against the Reapers, mission by mission. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mass Effect 3: Galaxy at War, Combat and Expansions
chapters.summary: War assets, probes, weapon mods, power combos, and the Leviathan, Omega and Citadel missions.

chapters.title: Across the Trilogy
chapters.summary: Insanity runs, romances, one Shepard through all three games, and kill counts.

StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Mass_Effect_Legendary_Edition
Fandom (masseffect.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://masseffect.fandom.com/wiki/Mass_Effect_Legendary_Edition
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but it is a compilation page with no subpages of its own; the guides live under the separate Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2 and Mass Effect 3 pages, so no structure was taken from it. masseffect.fandom.com answers the API, with about 94 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Delorean" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1328670. None of the 127 Steam achievements are hidden, and each description starts with ME1, ME2 or ME3, so chapters split cleanly by game. The ME2 and ME3 story chapters reveal plot through achievement descriptions, so they should stay spoiler-guarded.
